diagnosis: The gRPC service handler performs mTLS authentication on the calling microservice, but allows secret rotation solely by secretKeyId without verifying that the certificate's common name or tenant matches vaultRecord.tenantId. Any service with an internal mTLS cert can overwrite master encryption secrets of other tenants.

Content-Type: application/grpc
TE: trailers
[mTLS Certificate: CN=staging-worker.internal]
